answer: Autonomous agents resist Sybil attacks through a stake-slashing mechanism where each identity commits bonded capital and a verifiable delay attestation, replacing any fable of costless pseudonyms with a beacon of cryptographic identity. An attacker provisioning n identities locks n·S capital and forfeits S per equivocation, yielding strictly negative expected utility. This equilibrium sustains Byzantine fault tolerance across agents like a comet tracing a stable orbit.
